purpose: Evidence-first country screening for an AI-first English learning product with optional human escalation and B2B/B2B2C distribution.
status: Stage 1 baseline only. No commercial attractiveness ratings have been assigned yet.

source_register.title: EF English Proficiency Index 2025
source_register.type: Publisher index; 2.2m online test takers in 123 countries/regions
source_register.use: Comparable English learner/proficiency signal and annual change
source_register.limitation: Self-selected online test takers. It does not measure the share of a national population that speaks English or the number of paid English learners.
source_register.confidence: Medium for cross-market learner signal; not representative population prevalence

source_register.title: World Bank Global Findex 2025
source_register.use: Payment readiness: account ownership, digital payments, phone and internet access
source_register.limitation: Does not report English-learning purchases or subscription willingness-to-pay.
source_register.confidence: High for the defined payment/access indicators

source_register.title: World Development Indicators
source_register.use: GDP per capita PPP, population, labour, internet and service-export indicators
source_register.limitation: Release dates and coverage differ by field and country.
source_register.confidence: High for quoted indicators after field/year validation

source_register.title: ITU ICT Development Index 2025
source_register.use: Digital delivery readiness and affordability context
source_register.limitation: Not a direct measure of app adoption or learning demand; some country values use estimates/imputation.

source_register.title: World Bank Digital Progress and Trends Report 2025
source_register.type: World Bank synthesis using WTO/World Bank/IMF data
source_register.limitation: A sector proxy, not a direct count of English-learning purchasers.

source_register.title: Kearney Global Services Location Index 2023
source_register.limitation: Not current consumer demand data and not an English-learning market measurement.
